decision_rationale: E5 lost 0.013333 first-turn dense Recall@200 and 0.033333 first-turn union Recall@200 versus MiniLM. Across all query stages it improved dense Recall@200 by 0.078518 but produced fewer dense-only rescues beyond BM25 and a 0.001481 lower union recall, so the added semantic ranking did not create useful coverage. End-to-end fusion selection was not run.
